tickets.title: US004: Instant 'Sold Out' Toggle
tickets.description:
As a Kitchen Chef, I want to press a button on the Kitchen Display System to instantly mark an item as "Sold Out", so that students immediately stop ordering food we can no longer prepare.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: The Chef can toggle an "In Stock / Sold Out" status for any active menu item from the KDS.
2. Pass/Fail: Within 2 seconds of marking an item "Sold Out" (under normal network conditions), the item becomes unorderable on the mobile app.
